# fabric.yaml reference

<!-- Generated by sdk/python/tests/_reference_docs.py; a test keeps it equal. -->

`fabric.yaml` (schema `fabric.config/v1`) is what `fabric init` writes and every
command reads; the SDK and the Node never read it (the CLI compiles it into their
settings). For each setting the first source that sets it wins: a flag on the
command, then an environment variable already set, then fabric.yaml, then the
profile's default. Unknown keys are refused with the nearest valid key.

| Key | Values | Default (local) | Default (production) | Variable that overrides it |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | text | `PROJECT` | `PROJECT` |  |
| `profile` | `local` \| `production` | `local` | `production` |  |
| `shape` | `laptop` \| `linux-host` \| `container` \| `kubernetes` | none | none |  |
| `tenant` | text | `default` | `default` | `FABRIC_TENANT_ID` |
| `agent` | text | `PROJECT` | `PROJECT` | `FABRIC_AGENT_ID` |
| `providers.builtin` | `true` \| `false` | `true` | `true` |  |
| `providers.from_environment` | `true` \| `false` | `true` | `true` |  |
| `providers.custom` | list of mapping | `[]` | `[]` |  |
| `capture.content` | `true` \| `false` | `true` | `true` |  |
| `capture.privacy` | text | `profile-default` | `profile-default` | `FABRIC_CAPTURE_POLICY` |
| `capture.exec` | `true` \| `false` | `false` | `false` | `FABRIC_WIRE_EXEC` |
| `capture.http_hosts` | list of text | `[]` | `[]` | `FABRIC_WIRE_HTTP_HOSTS` |
| `capture.mcp` | `true` \| `false` | `false` | `false` | `FABRIC_WIRE_MCP` |
| `capture.security_context` | `null` or text | none | none |  |
| `node.mode` | `docker` \| `helm` \| `external` | `docker` | `docker` |  |
| `node.endpoint` | `auto` or text | `auto` | `auto` | `FABRIC_OTLP_ENDPOINT` |
| `node.queue_size` | `auto` or number | `auto` | `auto` |  |
| `destination` | mapping | `{"preset": "local-dir", "path": "./fabric-data"}` | none |  |
| `sensor.kind` | `auto` \| `ebpf` \| `auditd` \| `off` | `auto` | `auto` |  |
| `secrets.dir` | text | `auto` | `auto` |  |
| `secrets.id_key_file` | text | none | none |  |
| `secrets.ca_file` | text | none | none |  |

`PROJECT` stands for the project name (the directory's name by default).
